wallet.title: Wallets
wallet.subtitle: Where the money actually is: notes, a bank account, a mobile wallet — each one counted on its own.
wallet.belowZero: Below zero: more was filed out of this pocket than was ever filed into it.
wallet.openingUnset: No opening amount was ever set for this one, so this figure is only what has been filed to it since.
wallet.defaultNote: An entry logged with no pocket picked goes to this one.
wallet.closedNote: A closed wallet is not offered when you log an entry and it leaves the cards above. It is not deleted: the entries that point at it still resolve, and its movements still name it.
wallet.emptyBody: Add the pockets your money is really in — notes, a bank account, a mobile wallet — and each one gets a figure of its own.
wallet.errorTitle: Your wallets could not be read
wallet.errorNote: Nothing has been written, and no figure below is a guess. Try again when you are ready.
wallet.sumNote: These are your pockets side by side, not a balance. Your balance is income minus expense and it lives on the dashboard, and an opening amount you type in here is money that no entry describes.
wallet.nameHelp: What you call it, so you can tell it from the others.
wallet.kindHelp: Cash, a bank account or a mobile wallet. The icon on the card follows this.
wallet.hintHelp: Only there to tell two accounts apart. Never a full account number.
wallet.openingHelp: Money that was in this pocket before you started logging. Leave it empty if you do not know — an empty box is not the same as zero.
wallet.makeDefault: New entries go here by default
wallet.makeDefaultHelp: An entry logged with no pocket picked is filed to this one. Exactly one wallet can be the default.
wallet.closeBody: "{name}" stops being offered when you log an entry and leaves the cards above. Nothing is deleted: the entries that point at it still resolve, and its movements stay in the history below.
wallet.closed: "{name}" is closed. Its movements are still in the history below.
wallet.closeDefaultHint: This is where new entries go. Make another wallet the default before closing this one.
wallet.moveNotSpending: Moving money between two of your own pockets is not an expense. It is one movement recorded against both wallets at the same moment, and it changes no balance, no report, no chart and no budget.
wallet.moveAmountHelp: More than zero. The first wallet has to hold it, and the server says which figure is short if it does not.
wallet.moveNoteHelp: Optional. What the move was for, in a few words.
wallet.movePickBoth: Choose the two wallets the money is moving between.
wallet.moveSame: That is the same wallet on both sides. Pick where the money is going.
wallet.moveNeedTwo: Moving money needs two open wallets, and there is one here at the moment.
wallet.historyNote: Neither end of a move is spending, and a move never appears in your income, in your expenses or in your balance.
wallet.historyEmptyTitle: Nothing has moved between your wallets yet
wallet.historyEmptyBody: When money goes from one pocket to another it is listed here with both wallets named, and it stays listed whichever wallet you read it from.
wallet.unfiledBody: These are entries logged before wallets existed, and any logged since without picking one. They are in your balance and in every report exactly as they always were, but they are in no wallet's figure, so the cards above are not all of your money.
wallet.unfiledHow: To put one in a pocket, open that entry and choose a wallet. There is no button here that files them in for you, because guessing which pocket the money was in is how a balance goes quietly wrong.
wallet.unfiledShort.one: {n} entry is not filed to a pocket
wallet.unfiledShort.other: {n} entries are not filed to a pocket
wallet.pickerHelp: Which pocket the money was in when it moved. Leave it as "not filed" and the entry still counts in your balance; the wallet is only for showing the money where it was.
wallet.pickerFailed: No pocket can be picked just now. The entry still saves without one.
wallet.pickerNoneYet: There are no wallets to pick from yet, so this entry will be saved without a pocket.
